column1: # Target-layout map: Java package prefix -> Rust module (under ghidra-rs/src/).
# Single source of truth for BOTH the harness area-filter (scripts/portlib.py)
# and the AGENTS.md "Target layout" table (regenerate with: portlib.py gen-agents).
# Matching is by Java PACKAGE (not file location). Rules:
#   * A class is in the work queue iff its package matches some prefix here.
#   * For PLACEMENT, the LONGEST matching prefix wins (most-specific first below).
#   * Areas deliberately NOT ported (test, examples, scripts, dev-tooling, help,
#     doclets) are intentionally absent -> they stay out of the queue. See
#     todo.md "Post-Port" for the native-Rust equivalents to build later.
# --- ghidra.app.* : specific subtrees before the general catch-all ---
